assertions.name: R12_not_a_constituent_jones
assertions.unit: bool (0 = R12 neither equals nor divides any constituent Jones)

description: T1: R_12/C(y) is not a constituent-knot invariant and the net is not a braid closure. Separators: (A) R_12 q-span 12 >> every constituent Jones span (<=4), equals/divides none; (B) R_12 even in q lives in Q[y], y=q^2+q^-2, the isospin crossing-weight sector. NOTE: the S_3/cyclotomic Galois argument does NOT separate (the trefoil's own reduced Jones cubic is also non-cyclotomic); disc(C)=-152 => S_3 is recorded as structure only.

data.verdict: R₁₂ is NOT a constituent-knot invariant, and the net object is not a braid closure (scope (a)). (A) R₁₂ q-span 12 ≫ every constituent-knot Jones span (max 4); it neither equals nor divides any. (B) the net is the isospin difference Δ(n[u,d,d])−Δ(p[u,u,d]) of Hecke-trace amplitudes, differing only in the u/d crossing weights (∈ ℚ[q²]); R₁₂ is even in q ⇒ lives in ℚ[y], y=q²+q⁻², the crossing-weight sector — a representation object, not topological. C(y) has disc -152 ⇒ S₃ Galois, recorded as structure but NOT the separating invariant (the trefoil's own reduced Jones cubic is likewise non-cyclotomic).
data.galois_note: C(y) disc -152 ⇒ S_3, but this does NOT separate R_12 from knot invariants (trefoil reduced Jones cubic is also non-cyclotomic); separation is by (A)+(B), not Galois.
